title: Support or explicitly bound mixed same-path and different-path retired-check selections
outcome: A mixed set of individually retired checks either qualifies with selection-aware same-path checks or returns an intentional documented limitation, preserving current admissible evidence and no-credit rules.
acceptance: Behavioral coverage combines an older same-path root-rebound check and a newer different-path retired check in one request and verifies the chosen explicit policy.
Current admissible checks cannot be excluded, each selected run is authenticated independently, and request-local audited disclosure remains complete.
